script_text: Your ruling planet Pluto powerfully activates your 4th House this week, Scorpio, reshaping your private world from the inside. The Water sign intensity is turned up early week as Mercury in Taurus squares your Sun through the 7th House — expect tension in partnerships around shared finances. Wednesday is your turning point as Venus enters Gemini and lands in your 8th House, deepening your magnetic pull in love and transforming financial situations. By Thursday, Jupiter in Cancer trines your natal Mars from the 9th House — career doors fly open in publishing, education, or legal matters. The weekend, the Moon sweeps your 10th House, spotlighting your reputation. Wednesday is your power day because Venus sextiles Pluto, supercharging intimacy and creative magnetism. Sunday is your worst day as Mercury squares Saturn, forcing a difficult conversation. Bottom line, Scorpio — move slowly in love but boldly in career. Follow for your daily cosmic update.
